name: Nocturne
description: Nightscout-compatible diabetes management API with Row Level Security and multi-tenancy.
longDescription:
Nocturne is a modern .NET rewrite of the Nightscout diabetes management API with full v1/v2/v3 API compatibility. It adds multi-tenancy with PostgreSQL Row Level Security, a SvelteKit web UI, and optional chat bot integrations (Discord, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp).

After deployment, you must set two environment variables on both the -api and -web containers before the app will work correctly:

  • BASE_DOMAIN — your hostname, e.g. nocturne.example.com
  • ORIGIN (-web only) — full origin URL, e.g. https://nocturne.example.com

Configure data connectors (Dexcom, LibreLinkUp, etc.) and chat bot credentials through Settings → Administration in the Nocturne UI after first login. Credentials are encrypted at rest with the instance key.
